offering_description.value: The GEO Group operates prisons and immigration detention centers for government agencies, using facilities it owns or manages under contract. It also develops electronic monitoring equipment and provides community supervision, reentry programs, and secure transportation.

primary_products.value: GPS and radio-frequency ankle monitors; alcohol monitoring devices; mobile supervision software

primary_services.value: prison and detention center management; electronic monitoring; community supervision; reentry programs; secure transportation

customer_segment.value: B2G: federal immigration and corrections agencies, state corrections departments, local courts and probation agencies

end_markets.value: corrections; immigration detention and supervision; probation and parole; community reentry

revenue_model.value: project or contract: government contracts for facility management, detention capacity, monitoring, reentry programs and secure transportation; rental or leasing: correctional facilities leased to government agencies
revenue_model.category: project or contract; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs prisons, detention centers and residential reentry facilities for public agencies; service provider: provides custody, transport, monitoring and reentry services for corrections and immigration agencies; OEM / manufacturer: builds electronic monitoring devices for corrections and community supervision programs; software / platform: processes location data and mobile check-ins for supervising agencies
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; service provider; OEM / manufacturer; software / platform

specialization.value: related lines: corrections, immigration detention, electronic monitoring, community supervision, reentry and secure transportation

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: government procurement bids and contracts with corrections, immigration and community supervision agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: high: government authorization and oversight of confinement under federal immigration detention standards and state corrections rules

notes: It is unclear which monitoring products are sold separately from contracted services.
